clientSdk.name: VMware.Sdk.vSphere.ContentLibrary
clientSdk.note: The VCF 9.0 PowerCLI SDK package for the Content Library area of the vSphere Automation API. It is a metapackage whose RequiredModules pull in VMware.Sdk.vSphere, which carries the Initialize-ContentLibrary* model initializers. Installed by the environment as a prerequisite. It is never vendored into this repository.
